summary: Defines a DHCP option that gives a client its geographic coordinates, including latitude, longitude and altitude, each with a resolution indicator, plus the reference datum used. A network can use this to tell a device where it is. It was replaced by RFC 6225.

eli5.summary: When you join a network, the network can hand you a note saying where on the map you are standing. This was replaced by RFC 6225.

questions: dhcp coordinate based location configuration information
how does dhcp provide latitude and longitude
